canonical_project: Ujjain Smart City Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC)
notes: Official Ujjain Smart City Limited page states the Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC) is envisaged as the single control centre for Ujjain, comprising a main control room, situation room, server room and electrical rooms on the ground floor of the Mela Office, with systems running (VTMS, e-nagarpalika, Integrated Traffic Management System, iSWM, COVID activities). This is a municipal smart-city command/control facility with an on-site server room rather than a commercial/cloud data centre; no MW capacity published. Separate searches found no commercial colocation or hyperscale data centre in Ujjain.
